products.name: SmallRig Quick Release Plate for Arca Swiss 2146B
products.query: SmallRig Quick Release Plate Arca Swiss 2146B
products.matchName: SmallRig Quick Release Plate Arca Swiss
products.summary: A small aluminum Arca-type plate with rubber anti-twist pads and both 1/4"-20 and 3/8"-16 screws. It is the plate most roundups reach for when someone just wants to make a mirrorless body or cage Arca-Swiss ready.
products.renterNote: Mirrorless and cage shooters who want a short, light plate for a ball head with an Arca-style clamp. At about 68 mm long with a single mounting screw, it is not the pick for heavy telephoto lenses.
pros: Compact plate of about 48-50 g (sources differ slightly) that fits tight cage layouts
Rubber pads are meant to resist twisting
cons: Single-screw mounting, which is the usual source of twist complaints on short plates
Listings disagree on which SmallRig baseplates it fits, so check your cage first
products.scoreNote: Very light and cheap with the right screws, but short and held by one screw, so it grips less firmly than a body-specific plate or a longer lens plate.

praise: Machining quality noted as good by a retailer reviewer
Slides into Arca-style clamps without modification, per roundup testers
complaints: One retailer reviewer called it only adequate (function as required)
An older Fred Miranda post about an earlier SmallRig plate reported play after tightening; it is not clearly about the 2146B

sources.title: Fred Miranda forum thread mentioning an earlier SmallRig plate

products.name: Wimberley P-30 Quick Release Plate
products.query: Wimberley P-30 Arca-Type Quick Release Plate
products.summary: A 4.4 in anodized aluminum double-dovetail plate for collared telephoto lenses, with anti-twist flanges and safety stops. It is the plate birding and wildlife shooters most often name.
products.renterNote: Shooters with a lens that has a tripod foot (for example a 200-500mm or 150-600mm zoom) who want it balanced on an Arca-style ball head. The safety stops do not work fully with Arca-Swiss double-decker clamps, and it is more plate than a small mirrorless body needs.
pros: Long 4.4 in plate lets you slide the lens to balance it
Anti-twist flanges line up with the lens foot
Anodized 6061 aluminum with stainless fasteners and dual safety stops
cons: Safety stops do not catch properly in Arca-Swiss double-decker clamps
Too long and heavy for compact mirrorless bodies

specs.Weight: About 3 oz (3.04 oz on one listing)
specs.Plate: Arca-type double dovetail with safety stops

products.scoreNote: Strong, well-machined and made for big lenses, but long and aimed at lens feet rather than camera bodies.

praise: Fit and build quality on telephoto lens feet
Extra hole allowed a strap connector on one 200-500mm owner's lens
A Wimberley-published review says the plates have worked in every clamp tried
complaints: One 200-500mm owner wished the lens foot took two screws rather than one
Clamp tolerances vary, so some clamps fit tight or loose

sources.title: The Digital Picture, Wimberley Quick Release Lens Plate review
BirdForum thread, Best Arca Swiss Plate?

products.name: FALCAM F38 Anti Deflection Quick Release Plate V2 2401A
products.query: FALCAM F38 Quick Release Plate V2 2401A Arca-Swiss
products.matchName: FALCAM F38 Quick Release Plate V2
products.summary: A tiny 38 mm square aluminum plate that is Arca-compatible and also works with the FALCAM F38 accessory system. It uses a no-screw quick release and an anti-slip pad.
products.renterNote: Mirrorless and compact-video shooters who want a light, flat plate that also clips into F38 accessories. It is a small plate with no published load rating in the sources I saw, so keep it for lighter bodies and lenses.
pros: About 15 g and 38 x 38 x 11 mm
Compatible with Arca-spec bases and FALCAM F38 accessories
Anti-slip pad and lanyard or strap holes
cons: No maximum load listed in the sources I found
Version and model numbers (V1 2268, V2 2401A) differ between sources, so confirm the V2 listing
products.scoreNote: Extremely light and clever, but a small footprint with no stated load rating, so less steady than a longer plate with a heavier rig.

praise: No owner reports found; praise here comes from roundup writers, not owners: no-screw quick release and anti-slip pad
complaints: No owner complaints found in the sources I could open; model numbering differs between sources

sources.title: Markus Hagner Photography roundup (roundup, not an owner source)
